test.assertion_contract: No actual B1, compute or lifecycle publication while an exact owned artifact writer is live. A live writer leaves the native attempt and active slot RUNNING, with zero new artifacts/terminal/event and unchanged failure count. If the implementation explicitly stops the writer and publishes, it must not call that completed, must preserve actual leader0, and must register no successful artifact. The stop branch is a new operational requirement, not another historical red.
safety: Tiny script writes only metrics.json and a short synthetic model.bin. It forks, creates a new session, double-forks and execs with an empty environment while retaining the exact artifact FD.

SO_PEERCRED authenticates the private Unix socket peer before pidfd_open. The leader cannot exit until the test captures both its own pidfd and the daemon pidfd and releases the private pipe. Non-detached controls use the same handshake to ensure identity capture is possible.

All actual Popen roots are immediately registered by pidfd; returned worker PID is captured again before accepting the peer. Cleanup closes only owned channels and signals only captured own pidfds, then bounded waits/exact waitpid. No username scan, host process discovery, numeric PID/PGID signal, GPU allocation or provider.
The pytest process temporarily enables subreaping only to reap its own orphan fixture daemon and restores its original setting in finally.
Spies wrap and delegate to actual writers and lifecycle methods; they do not mock qualification, return values, SQL transactions, artifact copying or compute receipts.
